caption: The drawing is in black ink on a beige or off-white background and features two outlined objects placed side by side. On the left, there is an object resembling a bed headboard or footboard, with two vertical rectangular legs and a curved, rounded top. On the right, there is an object resembling a small cabinet or nightstand, composed of four vertical legs, a rectangular body, a horizontal bar at the top, a drawer with two round knobs in the upper section, and a single door with a round knob in the lower section. Both objects have simple, clean lines, some of which are double-lined for emphasis on detailing, particularly on the legs of the right object. At the bottom of the drawing, the text reads “ONE-EIGHTH INCH TO THE INCH” in capital letters, with a horizontal line above and below the text.
title: Wash Stand
